name: Online Edit
summary: Adversaries may execute an online edit of a PLC to update parts of an existing program. It does not require stopping the PLC which allows it to continue running during transfer and reconfiguration without interruption to process control. Adversaries may leverage this approach to minimize downtime and evade detection. The ability to perform an online edit to the PLC typically relies on access to a workstation with the vendor-specific PLC…

analytics.name: Analytic 2058
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) online-edit command sequence (incremental program modification while the device remains in RUN mode) from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, outside a scheduled change-control window. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect.
